settings.title: Settings
settings.colorblindNote: Every group has a symbol as well as a colour (● ▲ ■ ◆ ★). In colour-blind mode you also see it on a hinted tile.
settings.tierNote: Easy: everyday words, groups by meaning. Medium: common words and simple phrases. Hard: wordplay for native speakers. Each level has its own daily puzzle.

option.title: Reveal a group name
option.pair: Show two words that belong together

optionNote.title: See what links the easiest group you haven't found yet.
optionNote.pair: Two words from the easiest group you haven't found yet get marked with its symbol.

share.copied: Result copied – just paste it into a message.

0.title: Find the fours
0.text: The table is full of words. Four at a time have something in common. Pick them and tap Submit group.

1.title: Every group is a different challenge
1.text: Colour and symbol show the difficulty, from easy ● to the toughest ★. Watch out for tricky words that seem to fit elsewhere too.

2.title: Attempts, hints and points
2.text: You have 4 attempts. Get three out of four right and the game will tell you. Hints cost points; speed and bravery (solving a harder group before an easier one) earn extra.

daily.title: DAILY PUZZLE
daily.label: Kinzle #{n}
daily.upcoming: The first daily puzzle arrives on {date}.
daily.none: Daily puzzles are on their way.
daily.rerun: Encore: an older puzzle getting another round today.

bag.title: Seed pouch
bag.rareOne: Rare seed for a clean game
bag.empty: Your pouch is empty for now. Every group you solve adds a seed.
bag.intro: Every group you solve becomes a seed with its four words. A game with no mistakes and no hints gives a rare seed ✦. One day they will grow into a tree of words.

path.soon: The Journey board is being built and arrives in the next version.
path.lockedNote: Unlocks when you finish the previous chapter

info.skipped: Skipped · come back whenever you like
info.locked: Unlocks when you finish the previous level

path.skip: Skip for now and come back later
path.shard: A fragment of the First Word
path.notYet: Try the level again whenever you like.

free.title: Practice
free.note: Puzzles you have already finished on the Journey, plus older daily puzzles. No points, no timer, no mistake limit, free hints.
free.empty: Nothing here yet. Levels you finish on the Path and older daily puzzles will appear here.

archive.title: Archive
archive.note: Older daily puzzles. They don’t count towards leaderboards.
archive.empty: Nothing here yet – the archive grows every day.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.backupNote: Save your progress to a file and restore it on this or another device.
stats.importWarning: Progress and settings on this device will be replaced by the backup.

notebook.title: Notebook
notebook.intro: Fragments of the First Word you found on the Journey. Write down what you think it is – nothing is graded.
notebook.empty: No fragments yet. You’ll find the first at the end of chapter 1.
notebook.placeholder: I think the First Word is…

history.title: My games
history.empty: Nothing here yet. Every finished game will show up here.
history.noAttempts: Older games did not save individual guesses.

board.title: Leaderboard
board.intro: Join with a nickname and compare yourself with others – kids and grown-ups alike.
board.unavailable: The leaderboard is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment – you can keep playing.
board.disabled: The leaderboard is off in test mode.
board.notYet: Finish a daily puzzle or a Path level to appear here.
board.forgetText: Your nickname, results and seeds will disappear from the leaderboard. The game on this device stays as it is.

error.nickname_taken: That nickname is taken, try another one.
error.nickname_chars: Use only letters, digits, space, dot, dash or underscore.
error.nickname_bad: That nickname can’t be used, please pick another.

board.privacyStored: We only store your nickname, daily results, seeds and Path progress.
board.privacyDelete: You can delete it all at any time.
board.note: Points from daily puzzles (every level) and the Path. Under the points you see what each player added today.
board.empty: Nobody here yet. Be the first!

custom.title: Your own puzzle
custom.intro: Think up groups of four words. The first group is the easiest, the last the hardest. The puzzle is stored in a link you can send to anyone.
custom.author: Your name (players will see it)
custom.readyText: Send the link to anyone. Whoever solves it can send you their result.
custom.shareText: I made you a Kinzle puzzle. Can you solve it?
custom.copied: Link copied – just paste it into a message.
custom.label: By {author}
custom.brokenText: The puzzle in this link is damaged or incomplete. Ask the author to send it again.

error.title: Group {n}: name is missing.
error.word: Group {n}: fill in all four words.
error.wordLong: Group {n}: a word is longer than 12 characters.
error.duplicate: Group {n}: the same word appears twice.
error.tooMany: You sent 10 puzzles to this group today. More tomorrow.

party.title: Group
party.intro: A private group with its own leaderboard. See who has played today and send each other puzzles.
party.needNick: Groups need a nickname. Join the leaderboard:
party.none: You’re not in a group yet. Start one, or join with a friend’s code.
party.copied: Invite copied – just paste it into a message.
party.newPuzzle: Make a puzzle for the group
party.noPuzzles: No puzzles here yet. Make the first one!
party.removeText: The player leaves the group. They can only come back with the code.
party.deletePuzzleText: The puzzle disappears from the group for everyone.
party.leaveText: You can come back any time with the group code.

error.party_name_length: A group name needs 3 to 24 characters.
error.party_name_chars: Use only letters, digits and spaces in the name.
error.party_name_bad: That name can’t be used, please pick another.
error.too_many_parties: You can’t have any more groups.
error.party_not_found: No group has this code. Check it and try again.
error.party_full: The group is full (30 members at most).

together.title: Leaderboard
together.partyNewNote: A leaderboard just for family and friends
